records.jp: お昼の校内放送の時間です
records.en_original: It's time for your afternoon broadcast.
records.en_auxiliary: It's time for your afternoon broadcast.
records.en: It's time for your afternoon broadcast.

records.jp: 今日のコーナーは今気になるあの子に話を聞く<CR>『気になるあの子に会いたーい』です
records.en_original: Today's topic is, "All About Her," where we meet and chat with the classmates YOU've been wondering about.
records.en_auxiliary: Today's topic is "All About Her," where we meet and chat with the classmates YOU'VE been wondering about.
records.en: Today's topic is, "All About Her," where we meet and chat with the classmates YOU've been wondering about.

records.jp: 本日のゲストは１年Ａ組井上千紘さんです
records.en_original: Our guest today is from year 1, class A, Chihiro Inoue.
records.en_auxiliary: Our guest today is from year 1, class A, Chihiro Inoue.
records.en: Our guest today is from year 1, class A, Chihiro Inoue.

records.jp: ようこそいらっしゃいましたー
records.en_original: Welcome to our program!
records.en_auxiliary: Welcome to our program!
records.en: Welcome to our program!

records.jp: （千紘かー、大丈夫かな……<CR>というか、何で出演しようと思ったんだろう……）
records.en_original: (Chihiro, huh? Is she gonna be okay on radio? Actually, what made her want to be on this show in the first place?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Chihiro, huh? Is she gonna be okay on radio? Actually, what made her want to be on this show in the first place?)
records.en: (Chihiro, huh? Is she gonna be okay on radio? Actually, what made her want to be on this show in the first place?)

records.jp: ……よ……よろしく……お願い……します……
records.en_original: ...Th-Thank you...for having...me...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-thank you...for having me.
records.en: ...Th-Thank you...for having...me...

records.jp: （頑張れ千紘！）
records.en_original: (You can do it, Chihiro!)
records.en_auxiliary: (You can do it, Chihiro!)
records.en: (You can do it, Chihiro!)

records.jp: それでは、今日もさっそく質問を始めていきたいと思います。<CR>まず、井上さんの……
records.en_original: Alright, then let's get started on today's questions. First, Miss Inoue......
records.en_auxiliary: All right, then let's get started on today's questions. First, Miss Inoue...
records.en: Alright, then let's get started on today's questions. First, Miss Inoue......

records.jp: へえ……井上さんって多趣味なんですねー
records.en_original: Wow... I didn't know you had so many hobbies.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow... I didn't know you had so many hobbies.
records.en: Wow... I didn't know you had so many hobbies.

records.jp: あのー井上さん、マイクの前でうなずいても<CR>リスナーさんに聞こえないよ
records.en_original: Um, Miss Inoue, our listeners can't hear you if you just nod in front of the microphone.
records.en_auxiliary: Um, Miss Inoue, our listeners can't hear you if you just nod in front of the microphone.
records.en: Um, Miss Inoue, our listeners can't hear you if you just nod in front of the microphone.

records.jp: ……ご……ごめんな……さい……
records.en_original: ...I'm...s-sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...s-sorry.
records.en: ...I'm...s-sorry...

records.jp: （千紘、あとちょっとだから頑張って）
records.en_original: (You're almost done, Chihiro. Hang in there!)
records.en_auxiliary: (You're almost done, Chihiro. Hang in there!)
records.en: (You're almost done, Chihiro. Hang in there!)

records.jp: それでは気を取り直して……どうぞ
records.en_original: Then let's give it another try... Go ahead.
records.en_auxiliary: Then let's give it another try. Go ahead.
records.en: Then let's give it another try... Go ahead.

records.jp: はい……いろいろ……やって……ます……
records.en_original: Yes... I'm interested...in a lot...of things...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes... I'm interested... in a lot of things.
records.en: Yes... I'm interested...in a lot...of things...

records.jp: いやー、井上さんが趣味ではこんなに積極的だったなんて<CR>リスナーの皆さんも驚いてると思いますよ
records.en_original: Wow! I bet our listeners are also surprised to learn how much you're willing to share when it comes to your hobbies.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow! I bet our listeners are also surprised to learn how much you're willing to share when it comes to your hobbies.
records.en: Wow! I bet our listeners are also surprised to learn how much you're willing to share when it comes to your hobbies.

records.jp: ……ありがとう……
records.en_original: ...Thanks...
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thanks.
records.en: ...Thanks...

records.jp: それでは、お別れの時間も近づいてきておりますので<CR>次を最後の質問にしましょう
records.en_original: Well then, we're almost out of time for today, so let's make this the last question:
records.en_auxiliary: Well then, we're almost out of time for today, so let's make this the last question!
records.en: Well then, we're almost out of time for today, so let's make this the last question:

records.jp: ズバリお聞きします。井上さんが一番幸せだと思える瞬間は？
records.en_original: Tell us, in what moment do you feel the happiest?
records.en_auxiliary: Tell us, in what moment do you feel the happiest?
records.en: Tell us, in what moment do you feel the happiest?

records.jp: ……えーと……自分の……作った……もので……<CR>みんなが……よろこんで……くれた……とき……
records.en_original: Umm... When...people...thank me...for something...I made...
records.en_auxiliary: Umm... When people appreciate... something I made.
records.en: Umm... When...people...thank me...for something...I made...

records.jp: なるほどーやっぱり自分のやったことで<CR>他人に喜んでもらえるのはうれしいですね
records.en_original: Ah, I see. It's definitely a nice feeling when you can make someone smile.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I see. It's definitely a nice feeling when you can make someone smile.
records.en: Ah, I see. It's definitely a nice feeling when you can make someone smile.

records.jp: はい……
records.en_original: Yes...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes...

records.jp: ということでお時間が来てしまいました
records.en_original: Well, that's all the time we have for today.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, that's all the time we have for today.
records.en: Well, that's all the time we have for today.

records.jp: 井上さん今日はありがとうございました。<CR>それでは……
records.en_original: Thank you for joining us, Miss Inoue. So...
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for joining us, Miss Inoue. So...
records.en: Thank you for joining us, Miss Inoue. So...

records.jp: あの……実は……これ……わたしが作った……ぬいぐるみ……
records.en_original: Um...actually... Here's...a stuffed animal...I made...
records.en_auxiliary: Um, actually... Here's... a stuffed animal... I made.
records.en: Um...actually... Here's...a stuffed animal...I made...

records.jp: え、わたしにくれるの？
records.en_original: Oh, for me?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, for me?
records.en: Oh, for me?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: ありがとー。というか、めちゃくちゃ上手だね
records.en_original: Thank you! Wow, this is incredibly well-made.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you! Wow, this is incredibly well-made.
records.en: Thank you! Wow, this is incredibly well-made.

records.jp: リスナーのみなさん！　<CR>井上さんにぬいぐるみをいただきましたー
records.en_original: Listeners! I've just now received a stuffed animal from Miss Inoue.
records.en_auxiliary: Listeners! I've just now received a stuffed animal from Miss Inoue.
records.en: Listeners! I've just now received a stuffed animal from Miss Inoue.

records.jp: 細部まで作りこまれており、仕事の丁寧さがうかがえます。<CR>リスナーの皆さんにお見せできないのが残念なくらいです
records.en_original: It's beautifully crafted, right down to the stitching. Her work is dripping with care. I just wish I could show you!
records.en_auxiliary: It's beautifully crafted, right down to the stitching. Her work is dripping with care. I just wish I could show you!
records.en: It's beautifully crafted, right down to the stitching. Her work is dripping with care. I just wish I could show you!

records.jp: っと、本当はもっとこのぬいぐるみについて<CR>ご説明したいところですが時間がありませんので
records.en_original: Uh oh, while I'd love to expound upon the virtues of this precious plushie, I'm afraid we're out of time.
records.en_auxiliary: Uh oh, while I'd love to expound upon the virtues of this precious plushie, I'm afraid we're out of time.
records.en: Uh oh, while I'd love to expound upon the virtues of this precious plushie, I'm afraid we're out of time.

records.jp: お別れを言いたいと思います
records.en_original: It's time for us to say goodbye!
records.en_auxiliary: It's time for us to say goodbye!
records.en: It's time for us to say goodbye!

records.jp: リスナーの皆さん本日もお付き合いくださりありがとうございました
records.en_original: Thank you to all our listeners for tuning in today.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you to all our listeners for tuning in today.
records.en: Thank you to all our listeners for tuning in today.

records.jp: お相手は放送部の一之瀬亜子と……
records.en_original: Your hosts have been Ako Ichinose from the broadcasting club, and......
records.en_auxiliary: Your hosts have been Ako Ichinose from the broadcasting club, and...
records.en: Your hosts have been Ako Ichinose from the broadcasting club, and......

records.jp: ……井上……千紘……でした……
records.en_original: ...Chihiro...Inoue.
records.en_auxiliary: Chihiro... Inoue.
records.en: ...Chihiro...Inoue.

records.jp: それでは、さようなら
records.en_original: Take care, and good-bye.
records.en_auxiliary: Take care and goodbye.
records.en: Take care, and good-bye.

records.jp: （最後は、バタバタしたけど無事に終わってよかった……）
records.en_original: (The ending was rushed, but I'm glad it went well!)
records.en_auxiliary: (The ending was rushed, but I'm glad it went well!)
records.en: (The ending was rushed, but I'm glad it went well!)
